slides.text: Exam se ek raat pehle *yeh mat karo*
Raat bhar mat jaago. *Neend yaad rakhne mein madad karti hai.*
Bag, admit card, pen *pehle se* rakh lo.
Subah *10 minute* apne hi notes dekho.
Save karo. Exam se pehle dobara padhna.
slides.sub: Follow for one study rule a day

caption:
Exam se pehle ki raat ka plan chhota rakho: revise, so jao, aur shaant raho.

Kal kaunsa exam hai? Comment mein batao, all the best!
